'''Farn Klin''' was a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who studied the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Farn Klin, a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual of a [[Farn Klin's species|species]], was inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at a young age and began [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Stationed at the Temple throughout the war, Klin, joined by fellow student [[Ran Deezy/Legends|Ran Deezy]], attended a gathering of Jedi in a [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|Temple comm station]] when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] sent a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] transmission in which the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] gloated over his capture and [[Torture/Legends|torture]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]].<ref name="GI" />
